rules.statement: A transfer of property subject to a trust for charitable purposes is not a donation within the meaning of section 6(1A) of the Income Tax Ordinance, and thus is not taxable.
rules.supporting_quote: "I cannot ascribe any other reason for the specific mention of offertories and subscriptions. An offertory could be described as an offering in money or kind made by the faithful as part of a religious ceremony. A subscription is generally a contribution of money made when funds are being raised for a particular purpose."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 6 (1A) and section 78 of the Income Tax Ordinance.

meta.parties: Trustee, Chevaller Christian Gomes Charitable Trust v. Deputy Commissioner of Inland Revenue
